title: Max Number of K-Sum Pairs
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, you can perform an operation where you select two numbers from the array whose sum equals k and remove them.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, you can perform an operation where you select two numbers from the array whose sum equals k and remove them. Return the maximum number of such operations that can be performed on the array.
constraints: Each array entry may be used in at most one pair.
Return the maximum number of disjoint pairs whose values sum to k.
reference_solution:
def maximum_k_sum_pairs(nums, k):
 counts=Counter(nums);answer=0
 for value in list(counts):
  other=k-value
  if value>other:continue
  take=counts[value]//2 if value==other else min(counts[value],counts[other]);answer+=take
 return answer

hints: A value can pair only with its complement k-value.
Count values and process each unordered complement pair once.
For distinct values add the smaller count; for value=k/2 add count//2.
These choices consume every possible complement match and pairs from different value groups cannot compete.
